title: Record final acceptance coverage and operator-go/no-go checklist
description:
Write the final acceptance coverage record and the operator release go/no-go checklist. Each must state pass, fail, or pending honestly, based on evidence from the phase t artifacts.

Before editing, inspect:
- deploy/systemd/mike-trade-engine.service, deploy/systemd/mike-trade-dashboard.service, mike_trade/controls/service_manager.py (t.1)
- tests/paper_broker/test_alpaca_paper_cycle.py and tests/end_to_end/test_protective_live_guards.py (t.2)
- mike_trade/app.py, mike_trade/runtime.py, tests/end_to_end/test_full_product_cycle.py, tests/end_to_end/test_recovery_offline.py (t.3)
- docs/REQUIREMENTS.md, docs/SAFETY_AND_RISK.md, docs/TEST_PLAN.md, docs/DASHBOARD.md, docs/ALPACA.md (t.4)
- Makefile/CLI, migrations directory, dependency lock files, dashboard frontend build output configuration

Implementation requirements:
1. docs/verification/phase_t_complete_product.md: an audit artifact with a coverage table. Each required final acceptance item gets one row with columns for requirement, evidence (test file and test name, or document section/file path), status (PASS / FAIL / PENDING-EXTERNAL / NOT-RUN), and notes. Rows must include: 1 and 10 symbol shared-feed fanout; independent BUY/SELL rules/parameters; exactly one entry per cycle under repeated signals/partial fills; full remaining exit after minimum hold; daily entry-cycle count and restart/session reset; symbol and buy-strategy loss lockouts; persistent cooldown; concurrent budget race; stop coverage and no oversell; native/stepped trailing init, monotonic/multi-step, replace/close races; protection on partial fills; scenario/live isolation; deterministic shadow restart accounting; dashboard OFFLINE/stale; restart with outstanding orders/stops/external trade; early-close cutoff and default no EOD liquidation; stop/pause/close/flatten distinction; ledger/report reconciliation for whole/fractional fills; no-lookahead replay; complete Make/CLI surface; reproducible repository/deployment artifacts (locks, migrations, systemd units, compiled dashboard); the vwap_reference end-to-end proof; and credential-gated Alpaca PAPER acceptance. Record only results that were actually observed. Mark anything not executed as NOT-RUN, and mark paper credential/approval-dependent items as PENDING-EXTERNAL unless the operator supplied evidence. Include a section that lists known gaps, blocked/unverified provider combinations, and the explicit statements that no live orders were part of automated verification and that paper fills do not prove live performance.
2. docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md: an operator go/no-go checklist with checkbox items grouped as: repository and dependency lock reproducibility; migrations and DB integrity/backup/restore drill; credential env files and permissions per mode; systemd install/enable for the engine and the independent dashboard; doctor/provider/capability checks; startup reconciliation clean with no drift; dashboard reachable with the engine stopped (shows OFFLINE); shadow reference scenario run reviewed; paper lifecycle verified per supported protective combination; entry kill switch, pause, close, and flatten rehearsed in shadow/paper; risk limits and budgets reviewed; live enablement prerequisites with explicit live confirmation; and rollback procedure. Each item references the relevant doc or command. End with explicit NO-GO conditions: any FAIL, unresolved reconciliation drift, unverified protective combination intended for use, missing paper verification for LIVE, or credential permission violations.
3. Write documentation only. Do not modify code or tests.
acceptance_criteria: docs/verification/phase_t_complete_product.md contains a table with one row per required final acceptance item listed in the description, and each row has a non-empty evidence reference and one status value from PASS, FAIL, PENDING-EXTERNAL, or NOT-RUN.
The vwap_reference end-to-end proof row references tests/end_to_end/test_full_product_cycle.py, and the Alpaca paper row references tests/paper_broker/test_alpaca_paper_cycle.py.
Alpaca paper acceptance is marked PENDING-EXTERNAL unless operator-supplied execution evidence is recorded, and no row claims that a live-order check passed.
The verification document states that no live orders were part of automated verification and that paper fills do not prove live performance, and it lists blocked or unverified provider combinations.

docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md contains checkbox items covering lock reproducibility, migrations/backup/restore, credential permissions, systemd units, startup reconciliation, dashboard OFFLINE check, shadow reference review, paper verification, control rehearsals, risk limits, live enablement with explicit confirmation, and rollback.
docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md ends with explicit NO-GO conditions, including any FAIL status, unresolved reconciliation drift, and missing paper verification before LIVE.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts under .abracapocus/
record PASS for checks that were not actually executed and observed
claim Alpaca paper or live verification passed without operator-supplied credentials, approval, and evidence
run live orders, broad test suites, or backtests as incidental verification
